doc_metadata.notes: Appendix B3 specifies mandatory criteria for facilitation team effectiveness, including bilingualism, security clearance eligibility, and digital accessibility compliance.
doc_metadata.title: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, learning and organizational development services

evaluation_criteria.notes: Three mandatory pass/fail criteria for proposal eligibility: bilingualism, security clearance ability, and digital accessibility compliance.

source_refs.excerpt: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, learning and organizational development services; Appendix B3 - Facilitation team effectiveness

evaluation_criteria.title: Mandatory Criteria

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory criterion (a): Written confirmation of bilingual service delivery capability in English and French.

source_refs.excerpt: Bilingualism - Each proposal must provide written confirmation of the ability to provide all services, materials and solutions in both English and French.

evaluation_criteria.title: Bilingualism

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory criterion (b): All Service Provider resources must have ability to meet Bank's Reliability clearance requirements including electronic fingerprints, criminal record check, credit check, and security screening interview.

source_refs.excerpt: Security Clearance - All Service Provider resources involved in the delivery of services must have the ability to meet the Bank's Reliability clearance requirements. This will include electronic fingerprints, a criminal record check, a credit check, and potentially a security screening interview.

evaluation_criteria.title: Security Clearance

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory criterion (c): All digital learning content must comply with CAN/ASC - EN 301 549:2024, EN 301 549:2021, and WCAG standards per Accessible Canada Act requirements.

source_refs.excerpt: Accessibility - As a Crown corporation, the Bank is required to comply with the Accessible Canada Act (ACA). All digital learning content developed must comply with digital accessibility standards such as CAN/ASC - EN 301 549:2024 Accessibility requirements for ICT products and services (EN 301 549:2021 and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

evaluation_criteria.title: Accessibility
